findings.publicPainLayer: All 293860 rows share STATUS=VACANT and LANDSTATUS=null. All CREATED_DATE and LAST_EDITED_DATE are null. Conflicting native-key geometries cannot be selected by lifecycle/date. Prior conflicts retained.
findings.mutrah: Enabled the identified new-number subset: 12,212 source rows / 12,185 compound PLOTUID+NEWPLOTNO groups. All 22 repeated nonnull pairs were audited: disjoint components, agreeing new area and phase. Complete components are fetched before publication. 6,534 rows with null new plot number remain outside this subset.
findings.campingBasemap: Public basemap has295758 plot rows across six Muscat directorates. No PLOTUID field exposed. Complete new Wilayat/area/phase/plot references cover235489 rows, with at least2000 duplicate groups (aggregate result truncated); not a proven replacement identity.
findings.alignment: Both parcel layers returned ArcGIS499 Token Required on current direct reads.
findings.transport: Web Mercator viewport count/manifest disagreement resolved by four-corner projection to native EPSG:32640. Final 18-cell gate and 189 exact native lookups passed. Source geometry stays WGS84 to all downstream consumers.
findings.numericSeams: A source-disjoint pair gained a 0.0000062m² overlap in WGS84; nine-digit normalization reduced it to 0.000000062m². Runtime rejects overlap exceeding 0.0001m² (one square centimetre), plus mismatched new administrative references.
findings.measuredAreaSubset: Nonblank measured area did not resolve the older PAIN layer: 50 duplicate pairs included 13 overlapping competing geometries. It remains a separate recorded technical hold.

privacy: Only aggregate counts, source metadata and up to three native-reference examples per probe retained. No parcel geometry, owner data, credentials or imported tables.
searchResultAssociation: URLs are leads discovered across the recorded search pass; individual result lists were not retained.
